My name is Paul Rougieux, I am a wood products engineer and forest economist.

This site contains useful tools and data to analyse the forest sector. In case
you are curious about my setup, my favorite text editor is [Vim](vim.html) (now
Neovim). Inside tmux, I use vim slime to send commands to [bash](bash.html),
[ipython](python.html) and other interactive languages (such as [R](R.html) and
[SQL](postgresql.html)). I keep track of text, code and more thanks to Fugitive
and [git](git.html) version control. I love fzf. What about [agents](llm.html)?

This website was created using
[Rmarkdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/rmarkdown_websites.html) and the
[source code](https://gitlab.com/paulrougieux/paulrougieux) is available.
